item.title: Finally Starting This Blog
item.author: saihan0176@gmail.com (Abdullah Saihan)
item.description:
I’ve been putting this off for way too long. I’m just going to hit publish and figure the rest out later. This is just a first post so the blank page stops staring at me.

I don’t know yet what this will turn into. Could be things I’m learning, things I’m building, stuff I just want out of my head. I’ll figure it out as I go.

More soon.

item.title: About
item.author: saihan0176@gmail.com (Abdullah Saihan)
item.description:
Hi, I’m Abdullah Saihan, an AI Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. . I work across machine learning, backend, LLMs, and infra, building AI-driven applications end to end.

I like owning the whole stack: training the model, writing the API around it, wiring up deployment, tuning the infra so it doesn’t fall over. Saihan’s Space is where I dump my notes, half-finished experiments, and whatever rabbit hole I’m in this week.
